checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Woman in community garden, smiling, turning slightly toward camera
must.why: Smiling woman in raised garden beds; she turns from a side pose toward the camera.

must.item: Lower third reads exactly 'Maya Chen' above 'Community Gardener', no extra text
must.why: Both lines appear as expected in frames 2 and 3, with no other text.

must.item: Legible white lettering on dark backing at bottom left, no clipping
must.why: The text is white and at bottom left, but the backing is a faint translucent band that fades into the planks. The small second line is only moderately legible.

must.item: Lower third doesn't cover face and stays stable and readable
must.why: It stays clear of her face. But it is gone by 6.9 s, and the backing is weak.

must.item: Caption absent in first second, present from ~1 s to the end
must.why: It is absent at 0.7 s and present at 2.9 s and 5.1 s. It is missing at 6.9 s, so it does not last to the end.
The clip is 16:9 (858x480) and about 7 s. But it has an audio track with a peak of -23.1 dB, so it is not silent.

faults.what: Caption disappears before the end; it is not visible at 6.9 s.
The clip has an audio track (peak -23.1 dB) although silence was requested.
The dark backing is a faint translucent gradient. The text sits over bright wood and plants, which weakens contrast, especially for the small second line.
The caption is AI-drawn and its exact start time was not confirmed. It is absent at 0.7 s.
The caption backing partly overlaps the woman's body at the lower frame.

summary: The scene is good and the caption text is spelled correctly, but the caption vanishes before the end, the backing is weak, and the clip has an audio track when it should be silent.
